message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Here’s how: | Step | What to Do | Where to Go | |------|------------|-------------| | 1 | **Identify the type of noise** (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). | N/A | | 2 | **Gather details**: date, time, location, and any evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings). | N/A | | 3 | **Contact the City of Atlanta Police Department**:
• Phone: 404‑656‑4000 (non‑emergency line)
• Online form: https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | City of Atlanta Police Department | | 4 | **Submit the complaint**: Provide all gathered details and any evidence. | City of Atlanta Police Department | | 5 | **Follow up**: You’ll receive a reference number. Use it to track the status of your complaint. | City of Atlanta Police Department | **Additional Tips** - If the noise is from a commercial establishment, you can also contact the **Atlanta Office of the Mayor** or the **Atlanta Department of Planning & Development** for enforcement of zoning or business licensing regulations. - For persistent or severe complaints, consider filing a formal written complaint with the **City of Atlanta’s Office of the City Attorney**. **Quick Links** - [City of Atlanta 311 Service](https://www.atlantaga.gov/311) – Submit online or call 404‑656‑4000. - [Atlanta Police Department Contact Page](https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/police) – Find additional resources and contact information. Feel free to let me know if you’d like help drafting a formal complaint or if you have any other questions!
